description:
`create_issue` returns only the new id, so the CLI reloads the issue from storage to report it. This makes creation return the created issue.

## Background

`CommandExecutor::create_issue` (`crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs`, reached through the issues facade) returns `Result<(String, Vec<String>)>`: the new id and warnings. `IssueCommands::Create` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` then calls `storage.load_issue(&id)` to build its response. About 390 call sites across `crates/jit` (including `test_utils.rs` and the integration suites) and `crates/server` (`lib.rs`, `routes.rs` tests and `crates/server/tests/`) destructure the returned tuple, almost all only for the id.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `create_issue` returns a value carrying the created `Issue` as stored and the warnings it returns today, and the returned issue equals what storage holds after creation, shown by a harness test through `CommandExecutor` over `InMemoryStorage`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The CLI create path reports the returned issue and makes no `load_issue` call.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every caller compiles against the new return value, with test call sites reading the id from the returned issue, and the existing suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Notes

The call-site rewrite is mechanical and compiler-driven. Other mutations change their return values separately. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Issue creation returns the created issue
